payload.text: 0184 SECOND (vc's word, filed at f6a3c02d from dc's and vc's measurements, shellcheck -x peaking at 2.07 to 2.17 GB on bin/devbin): the lint gate sizes its parallel run by CPUs and never by memory, so a host with many CPUs and too little memory has checks killed, each read as a breach. The Fix proposes checking a killed or verdict-less file again, alone, before it counts. Built on 0180 once it lands; if a second run is the wrong shape once in it, send vc the case.
